description: This Java source file, TechDataServices.java, provides a set of services related to manufacturing technology data within the Ofbiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving routing tasks, checking routing associations, managing tech data calendars, and capacity calculations based on calendar schedules and exceptions.

classes.name: TechDataServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for manufacturing technology data management, including calendar and routing task operations.

methods.name: lookupRoutingTask
methods.description: Retrieves routing tasks based on name and machine group, filtered by active status and task type.

methods.name: checkRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Checks for conflicting routing task associations with the same sequence number within a specified date range.

methods.name: getTechDataCalendar
methods.description: Fetches the TechDataCalendar associated with a routing task, defaulting if none is associated.

methods.name: dayStartCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the first day starting from a given date that has non-zero capacity in the calendar week.

methods.name: capacityRemaining
methods.description: Calculates remaining capacity for a calendar on a specific date, considering exceptions.

methods.name: startNextDay
methods.description: Moves to the next available day in the calendar to start scheduling, returning the date and capacity.

methods.name: addForward
methods.description: Advances a timestamp forward by a specified duration, only through available calendar periods.

methods.name: dayEndCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the last day with available capacity up to a given day in the calendar week.

methods.name: capacityRemainingBackward
methods.description: Calculates capacity remaining moving backward in the calendar for a given date.

methods.name: endPreviousDay
methods.description: Finds the previous available day in the calendar, returning the date and capacity.

methods.name: addBackward
methods.description: Moves backward in calendar scheduling based on available capacity, adjusting the date accordingly.

methods.name: getExceptionCapacityForDate
methods.description: Helper method fetching exception day capacity if defined for a specific date.
